build_region_assigner: build a RegionAssigner instance with custom center_ratio and ignore_ratio for anchor assignment
assign_gt_to_anchors: assign ground truth bounding boxes to multi-level anchors using RegionAssigner assign method
calc_region_for_bbox: calculate the region of a bounding box defined by a ratio from center to every edge
check_anchor_centers_in_region: check whether anchor centers are inside a given region using anchor_ctr_inside_region_flags
review_region_assigner_algorithm: review the RegionAssigner class and its multi-level anchor to ground truth assignment algorithm
